utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I heard the repair drive is coming along — did you already drop anything off, or are you still figuring out what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t dropped anything off yet, but I’m still figuring out what they need. If you have the list, I’d appreciate a clear plan so I can bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll check the list and bring you a clear rundown. I can swing by after my errands and let you know exactly what they’re asking for.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at the loose fence panel and the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — that helps a lot. I’ll note the fence panel and porch light for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to confirm the date, who’s bringing tools, and where everything’s getting dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — can you confirm the date and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supply list for the repair drive. Let me know what you still need, and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll stop by after my errands and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I’ve got it right, what time and location are we using for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think we said Saturday morning at the community center, but I’m a little fuzzy on the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll treat it as Saturday morning at the community center for now, and we can pin down the exact time before we confirm anyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still gathering items, and the biggest need right now is tools and spare parts. I can fill you in on the drop-off times if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be great — what are the drop-off times? I can swing by with a few things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Sam — could you bring your drill and a few extra screws? I’ll handle the rest and we can sort the repair drive setup together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few extra screws. See you at the repair drive, and we’ll sort the setup together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations—where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start with the school parking lot after pickup, then the community center tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note the school parking lot after pickup and the community center tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and signing up to help. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—please do! I’ll start spreading the word in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Quinn—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything new. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the usual house stuff—loose hinges, leaky taps, and a few broken outlets. If you’ve got a list, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—do you want me to list the fixes by priority, or just bring what I can?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll pass it along and let you know if anyone has questions.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. What’s the latest on your end?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’m still sorting out a few things, but I’m here and I can help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s good to hear, Uli. If you can, please help me list the tools and supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are gathering tools and donations over at the community center this afternoon. If you want, I can point you to where they’re setting up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Tess. I’d like to know exactly where to go and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center gym, just off Maple Street near the playground. Bring any spare tools, gloves, or a few canned goods if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — could you bring a screwdriver set and some work gloves? That’ll help a lot at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what’s the repair drive needing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hands, I think. If you’ve got time, I’d be grateful for help sorting the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Tell me where to start, and I’ll help sort the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive focus, and do you need me to help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is focused on small home fixes and donated tools for folks on the block. If you can help sort items or keep track of what comes in, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can sort items and keep track of what comes in. Just point me to the table when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. What part do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’d be great, Jules — I’d love help spreading the word. Could you also point me to anyone who knows tools or can help with the bigger repairs?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for anyone handy with tools and let you know who can take on the bigger repairs. I can also connect you with a few neighbors who’d be happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. Remind me what changed again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We shifted it to Saturday morning at the community hall, and folks are bringing tools and spare parts. I can resend the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday morning at the community hall—got it. Yeah, please resend the details so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s going well so far — we’ve got a few fixes lined up and I’m lending a couple tools to keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that sounds promising. Let me know if you need anything else while you’re at it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly sorting donations and loading boxes. If you can help for an hour, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help for an hour. Tell me where to show up and I’ll start sorting and loading boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should double-check the schedule and make sure the tools and donations are all accounted for before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good call—do you want me to check the tools list while you confirm the donations?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll confirm the donations now, and let’s compare notes before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put me on the list—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you now and let folks know you’re helping with supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thank you, Faye. Maybe Saturday morning, after the school run, would be best.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning after the school run works for me. If you want, I can help line up people around that time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. I’ll send the first update as soon as I have the list together.
